notes.title: Major update V1.46
notes.content: [p]Thank you for all your amazing feedback! After a month of work, here’s what’s new:[/p][h3]🔧 Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Faster texture loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting & effects (no quality loss).[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified enemy spawn calculations → less lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized AI processing → smoother gameplay with large armies.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 Smarter AI[/h3][list][*][p]Enemies now take cover behind obstacles – flank them for max damage![/p][/*][*][p]Allied units defend themselves [b]and[/b] protect nearby allies.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Units getting stuck behind rocks/trees when taking cover.[/p][/*][*][p]Unit group formation issues in some languages.[/p][/*][/list][h3]✨ Other Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Red circle cursor when area is inaccessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Countdown icon added to thrown dynamite.[/p][/*][*][p]French translation fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Russian translation fixed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🔥 More updates are coming – keep sharing your feedback to help us improve![/p]

notes.title: Major Upgrade V1.44
notes.content: [h3]Major Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Group Creation[/b] → Use [b]Alt + Num (0–4)[/b] to create groups and select them with the numpad. Strategy just got smoother![/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Overhaul[/b] → No more shaky terrain-following. The camera now glides softly across the map. Zooming in slows movement for better unit tracking, and rotation is capped to avoid a flat top-down view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mini-map Power-Up[/b] → Move across the battlefield with a click, and even select units directly from the mini-map.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]keyboard shortcuts[/b] to the pause menu (Esc now opens/closes pause and sub-menus).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a [b]unit selection bug[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]In the unit bar, [b]double-click an icon[/b] to select all soldiers of that type.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Korean translation[/b] (thanks to a translator upgrade!).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Preview
notes.content: [p]I’ve read all your feedback, and a big update is on the way. Here’s what’s planned:[/p][list][*][p]Smoother camera movement[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard shortcuts to create and select unit groups[/p][/*][*][p]Double-clicking a unit icon in the unit bar to select all units of that type[/p][/*][*][p]Escape key to enter and exit the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement by clicking on the minimap[/p][/*][*][p]Improved translations[/p][/*][/list][p]This should take no more than a week.[/p][p]More improvements will come later, but I can’t confirm a date yet. Some ideas include: a more flexible building system, improved AI, and skirmish battle maps.[/p]

notes.title: Vsync option
notes.content: Added a VSync option to the settings.

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
Many improvements have been made to the game:

[list]
[*] You can now select a unit category with a double left-click

[*] Yankee cavalry behavior is now more predictable

[*] GUI improvements (centered text, more information)

[*] Additional information has been added to cover elements (number of slots, protection bonus)

[*] Camera movement has been reworked (move by bringing the mouse to the edge of the screen, prevents the camera from clipping through scenery, smoother motion)

[*] More frequent auto-save points

[*] No more prestige needed to upgrade units. Units now upgrade automatically based on the number of enemies they eliminate

[*] Numerous bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Camps management
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Captured Camps Become Bases:[/b] Captured enemy camps can now be used as bases, allowing players to establish new strongholds and manage their operations more effectively.

[*] [b]Recruitment from Multiple Strategic Points:[/b] Units can now be recruited from captured camps, improving deployment flexibility and battlefield strategy.

[*] [b]Building Construction at Multiple Bases:[/b] Players can now construct buildings in various captured camps, expanding their base management and territorial control.

[*] [b]New Construction Animation:[/b] Instead of an instant cinematic, buildings now require soldiers to complete construction, adding realism and strategic depth to the building process.
[/list]
